nws_live_behavior: Fetches current NWS conditions + active alerts for Phoenix area
nws_replay_behavior: No live NWS network request. Returns 'NWS current context not included in historical Replay'
replay_network_calls: Zero FortyGuard network calls. Zero NWS network calls.
ranking_tolerance: 0.1°C — candidates within this threshold are flagged as near_tie
replay_ranking_status: near_tie (fixture candidates differ by ~0.0004°C, well below 0.1°C threshold)
near_tie_disclosure: UI displays explanation that candidates are effectively tied and additional context would be needed
dynamic_content_sanitization: All dynamic content rendered via textContent/createElement — no innerHTML for user/NWS/provider data
hostile_input_test: HTML in question text is stored as text, not executed as markup
evidence_chain_rendering: Uses textContent for all dynamic values including user-derived question text
mode_allowlist: Only 'replay' and 'live' accepted. Invalid modes return 400.
public_error_policy: Bounded error messages ('Unable to complete query'), no stack traces, no credential exposure. Server-side diagnostic logging without credentials.
